metadata.description: Agent skills and plugins from cbs Corporate Business Solutions.

plugins.name: cds-guard
plugins.description: Sets up @cbs-consulting/cds-guard in CAP and UI5 projects and keeps coding agents from changing protected CDS entities, annotations, code blocks and files by accident.

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-cds
plugins.description: Sets up @cbs-consulting/eslint-plugin-cds in SAP CAP projects and lints .cds files as you edit them.

plugins.name: virtual-key-mapper
plugins.description: Sets up vkm (Virtual Key Mapper): signs in to your company LLM gateway, connects Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other tools with short-lived keys, and assigns the labels that attribute each request to a repository.
